text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the train ride home from going out with Narita Brian...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah, Brian!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Teio, huh...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Heading back from an outing?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I see. Where did you go?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Around there. It's not an interesting story, even if you ask.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... But that's for me to
decide, isn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that reminds me! I heard this super interesting
story. So basically—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Are you heading straight back to the academy too, Brian?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
What're you gonna do when you get home?
Eat dinner? Take a bath? Do some extra training?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I haven't decided.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Jeez! The conversation isn't going anywhere at all!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer!
Got anything interesting to talk about?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Because~ whenever I try to start a conversation with Brian,
she shuts it down with just one word!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You've got something up your sleeve, right, Trainer?
Like a topic Brian might actually bite on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A topic that would hook Narita Brian and get her excited...
choice_data_list: Race you back to the academy!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: That's hardly a topic to talk about...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Sounds good! Hey, Brian, let's race!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I refuse. It's a pain.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ehh~...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Still, I'd like to run against you.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Really!? In that case—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Not now.
I'll make time later, between training sessions."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It's a promise, okay? Don't you forget it!
I'll ask you every day just to make sure!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Cut it out. That's irritating.
You're already annoying enough as it is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the two of us got thoroughly hyped up
talking about training and races.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm curious about that too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Aren't you always in the student council room anyway?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
B-But still, nobody told me
about anything work-related.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Speaking of which, what does Brian even do all day?
Act as the Prez's bodyguard or something?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
What do you take me for...?
Besides, joining the student council in the first place was just Rudolf taking matters into—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, the three of us headed home while chatting excitedly about the student council.
